If tools/lints/_deps.py or scripts/_output.py is missing from the set, it raises RuntimeError, so an empty or broken probe cannot pass silently. Today the set is _output.py, _deps.py and _output_lints.py. _follower_cases computes the set once and seeds both itf and itg with it. What the recipe reads: module-level imports (_output, _output_lints, then install_path) plus render(), which AST-parses every .py under the fixture's scripts/ (_module_files -> _output.lint_py_files) and the guide. Over the closure the recipe still really renders and writes a map. A module render() loaded lazily would make _write_map fail (check=True), not pass.
